exams.notes: Uniform and comprehensive examination testing knowledge and qualifications in planning and design of plumbing systems, manual skills in plumbing, and knowledge of the State's minimum code of standards.

requirements.value: Applicant must be at least 21 years of age, and the Board must find that the requirements for registration or licensing of plumbers in such other state or municipality were substantially equal to Illinois requirements at the date of registration or license, and that the same privilege of registration is accorded by said state or municipality to Illinois licensed plumbers. Alternatively, if no reciprocal agreement exists, the applicant may obtain an Illinois license by passing the Illinois plumber's examination and paying required fees.

name.quote: There is created an Illinois State Board of Plumbing Examiners which shall exercise its duties provided in this Act under the supervision of the Department.

authority.value: Aids the Director and the Department by preparing examination subject matter, suggesting rules for examinations and hearings, submitting recommendations for efficient administration, grading all tests and examinations, and performing other duties prescribed by the Director. The Board exercises its duties under the supervision of the Department.
authority.quote: The Board shall aid the Director and the Department by: (a) Preparing subject matter for examinations as provided in this Act. (b) Suggesting rules to govern examinations and hearings for suspension, revocation or reinstatement of licenses. (c) Submitting recommendations to the Director from time to time for the efficient administration of this Act. (d) Grading all tests and examinations for licenses and promptly reporting the results to the Director.

bonding_required.quote: Applicants shall submit, on a form provided by the Department, an indemnification bond in the amount of $20,000 or a letter of credit in the same amount for work performed in accordance with this Act

insurance_required.quote: Applicants shall submit an original certificate of insurance documenting that the contractor carries general liability insurance with a minimum of $100,000 per occurrence, a minimum of $300,000 aggregate for bodily injury, property damage insurance with a minimum of $50,000 or a minimum of $300,000 combined single limit, and workers compensation insurance with a minimum $500,000 employer's liability.

definition_quote.value: "Plumbing" means the actual installation, repair, maintenance, alteration or extension of a plumbing system by any person.

methods_authorized.quote: "Plumbing" means the actual installation, repair, maintenance, alteration or extension of a plumbing system by any person.

license_tiers.quote: "Plumber" means any licensed person authorized to perform plumbing as defined in this Act, but does not include retired plumbers as defined in this Act.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: Apprentice plumbers must perform all plumbing under the direct personal supervision of the sponsor or his or her agent, who must also be an Illinois licensed plumber. First and second year apprentices require direct personal supervision for all work except second-year maintenance and repair. All other apprentices require daily inspection after initial rough-in and after completion by the sponsor or agent.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: "Supervision" with respect to first and second year licensed apprentice plumbers means that such apprentices must perform all designing and planning of plumbing systems and all plumbing as defined in this Act under the direct personal supervision of the sponsor or his or her agent who must also be an Illinois licensed plumber

apprentice_to_supervisor_ratio_regulated.quote: No licensed plumber shall sponsor more than 2 licensed apprentice plumbers at the same time.
